Replace each `___` with code, remove `#| eval: false` and run the chunk. Write answers under the chunks.

**Question for today:** How did life expectancy change in each continent since 1952?

```{r}
#| label: setup
pacman::p_load(here, tidyverse, janitor, countrycode)
```

## 1. Download the CSV once

Run this chunk one time. It saves a copy of the file in your `data` folder.

```{r}
#| label: download
#| eval: false
read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQMKvrshkL1R55vcnXnXQ14VfJM6HB62bed8U6ukVc-9ncRg79co2GoaS84eb1o4aEg1bqLFiWNJAS3/pub?gid=554197504&single=true&output=csv") |>
  write_csv(here("data", "gapminder.csv"))
```

## 2. Add continent and subregion

`countrycode()` takes the names, the `origin` (what we have) and the `destination` (what we want). Use `"continent"` and `"un.regionsub.name"`.

```{r}
#| label: prepare
#| eval: false
here("data", "gapminder.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(population = pop, income = gdp_percap) |>
  mutate(
    continent = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "___"),
    subregion = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "___"),
    .after = country
  ) |>
  write_csv(here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv"))
```
